suites.scannerScope: one case of four: it reads a committed SQL migration and asserts RLS is enabled, a SELECT grant exists and no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE grant exists
suites.rationale: Red 3 of 4 on ONE cause, and the cause is the test, not the module. The three data-source cases mock @/lib/supabase-server, which quarantine-audit-supabase.ts does not import: the module reads through getAzureWriteFluentClient from @/lib/data-plane/postgresCompat, so the mock never reaches it and each case throws on a missing database URL before any assertion runs. Module and test arrive in the same single commit (5d795a3976), so the pair shipped disagreeing and the suite has never passed. The fourth case is a migration-text check; the grants of an append-only audit table are the subject, and no in-process run can answer them, so textIsTheSubject is true. A triage may not edit a file it judges, so the repair (mock the module the code actually calls, and move the grant check to where migrations are verified) is filed, not done.
